posts.title: New games added every week
posts.summary: Check back often. We add new free PC games to every category.
posts.body:
We add new free PC games to every category, so check back often.

Use the Games page to filter by category and find something you like.

posts.title: How to install a downloaded game
posts.summary: Download, unzip, run the setup file, and you're ready to play.
posts.body:
Download the game from its official page.

If it comes as a zip file, right-click it and choose Extract All.

Open the extracted folder, run the setup file, and follow the steps on screen.
